record.context_brief: p-compact groups and telescopes of finite groups
record.original_question: Given a p-compact group X, does there exist a sequence of finite groups G_0 -> G_1 -> G_2 -> ... and homomorphisms between them such that the homotopy colimit of the classifying spaces B G_i is homotopy equivalent to B X after p-completion? Equivalently, is every p-compact group a telescope of finite groups in the sense that hocolim_i B G_i recovers B X up to p-completion?

evidence.quote: Question 1.1 Is every p-compact group a telescope of finite groups? In more precise words, given a p-compact group X, does there exist a sequence of finite groups and homomorphisms {G0 -> ... -> Gi -> ... } and a homotopy equivalence hocolimi BGi ' BX, up to p-completion?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let p be a prime. A p-compact group is a triple (X, BX, e) where BX is a pointed space which is Fp-complete (in the sense of Bousfield–Kan), X is a loop space with X ≃ ΩBX, and the mod-p cohomology H*(X; Fp) is finite-dimensional over Fp.

Question: Given any p-compact group X, does there exist a sequence of finite groups and group homomorphisms
   G_0 → G_1 → G_2 → · · · → G_i → G_{i+1} → · · ·
such that, after applying the classifying-space functor, the induced map on the homotopy colimit yields a homotopy equivalence
   (hocolim_i BG_i)^∧_p ≃ BX
after Bousfield–Kan p-completion? Equivalently, is every p-compact group realizable as a "telescope of finite groups" in this sense?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches did not surface a definitive resolution of the question of whether every p-compact group is a telescope of finite groups in the sense of a homotopy colimit of classifying spaces of finite groups recovering BX after p-completion. Related work by Castellana and others on normalizer decompositions of p-local compact groups is ongoing, but no source clearly confirms the question is solved or refuted.

status_evidence.title: p-compact group — nLab
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of p-compact groups and their classification; no statement of resolution of the telescope-of-finite-groups question.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution of the telescope question is recorded in the standard nLab survey of p-compact groups.

status_evidence.title: Normalizer decompositions of p-local compact groups (arXiv:2301.09259)
status_evidence.snippet: Generalizes normalizer decompositions to p-local compact groups, building on related decomposition results for finite groups and compact Lie groups.
status_evidence.claim: Recent decomposition results expand techniques relevant to the question, but do not assert that every p-compact group is a hocolim of BG_i for finite G_i.

status_evidence.title: The Classification of p-Compact Groups (Grodal, ICM)
status_evidence.snippet: ICM survey on the classification of p-compact groups; the telescope-of-finite-groups characterization is not stated as established.
status_evidence.claim: Authoritative survey of p-compact groups does not confirm the telescope characterization as solved.
